methodology.comparison: Each default-versus-opt-in comparison uses the same released Ohm toolchain and one host. Matched validation and current sessions run on Linux host A; the workflow and ablation matrices and historical Ruff pairs run on Linux host B. No cross-machine timing comparison.

matched_target_scope.codex-core: library test target, test profile; clippy --lib --profile test

matched_arms: separate Clippy followed by the same tests
methodology.matched_ordering: All six permutations across six incremental repetitions; one cold run per arm.
methodology.timers: Matched cycle values sum command timers. Replay wall_seconds measures the whole loop, including edits, pre-command idle checks, and runner bookkeeping; command/edit/warmup totals remain separate.
methodology.unchanged_sessions: All recorded commands retained, including standalone Clippy; two repetitions with reversed arm order.
methodology.ablation: Four public-API-hash/procedural-macro-cache configurations crossed with opt-in off/on; two repetitions.
methodology.maintenance: Periodic VM infrastructure and ordinary system/security services remained enabled; raw CPU and maintenance receipts are retained. Outside CPU telemetry starts during Codex cold builds; all 76 timed uv components and one Codex cold component in the matched study have only the quiet preflight and compiler monitor.
methodology.cfg_behavior: Combined compilation preserves normal Rust cfgs. Standalone Clippy may differ for cfg(clippy) code and diagnostics.
methodology.tests_started: Raw output-derived count, including repeated or nested output; final Codex selection is attested separately.
methodology.cache_footprints: Logical bytes and stat-allocated blocks counted once per regular-file inode within each recorded root, not physical or reclaimable COW space.

excluded_initial_attempt.reason: transient ld.bfd could not be classified by the parent-only process monitor; entire attempt excluded; restarted with the existing process-group-aware replay monitor

rejected_session_preflight.reason: Initial session preflight exceeded the I/O-wait threshold; retained and restarted with a fresh complete quiet gate.

rejected_matrix_preflight.reason: First libtest preflight dipped below 95 percent idle; retained and restarted with a fresh complete quiet gate.

untimed_uv_cache_repair.reason: Offline uv warmup lacked html-escape 0.2.15; no uv timed sample started.

codex_environment_diagnosis.scope: All remaining current and historical session pairs use inherited umask0022 and TMPDIR=/tmp/ohm-cr10; fixtures and test selections are unchanged.

historical_host_handoff.scope: Pause only the outer queue. The active current replay and all its children continue. After the replay exits, terminate the unused queue and old observers; retain their traces and attest the completed current source and test selections separately.

codex_system_cpu_exclusion.scope: Entire Codex/default/repetition0 timing excluded after substantial Falcon/system CPU overlapped measured commands. Source correctness and3439unique-selection proof retained. Combined warmup independently rejected for unattributed cc3533770.

linux-host-a.method: Completed timed commands, including Codex observations with a disclosed system-CPU limitation; command windows inferred from log final-write mtime minus measured duration. The log is written immediately after command completion. CPU intervals are about two seconds, so boundaries are approximate. Overlapping intervals are clipped to their first chronological coverage, making covered time a union rather than a sum. The system/user fields group other-UID versus current-UID processes; they are not CPU execution-mode counters. Missing early telemetry is explicit; this audit does not establish zero interference or change sample acceptance.
